A '''wooden axe''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], crafted from {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. It mines at speed 2 and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_axe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/wood/axe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines axe blocks at speed 2.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 0.8.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
